read.en: This is my dad. This is my grandpa.
I'm Ann. This is my brother, Tim.
I'm Tim. This is my sister, Ann.
Who is she? Who is she?
She's my mum. Can you see?
Who is he? Who is he?
He's my dad. Can you see?
I'm Joe. This is my dad.
A for ant. B for bear.
C for cow. D for dog.
Ant, ant, ant. Bear, bear, bear.
A cow and a dog. A dog and a cow.
How are you? How are you?
Hello, kids! Welcome to my farm.
Some orange juice for you, Ann.
E for elephant. F for frog.
G for giraffe. H for hen.

units.name: Unit 3
units.title: 学习用品
units.en: What do you take to school?

read.en: Two for you and two for me.
Two for you and one for me.
Sorry, Miss Jones. Mary, this is your pencil case.
I for insect. J for jellyfish.
K for kangaroo. L for lion.
I can draw. I can draw.
I can write. I can write.
I can read. I can read.
I can sing. I can sing.
I can dance. I can dance.
Hello, everyone! My sister can dance. My grandma can play the violin. My grandpa can sing. I can ride a bike!
M for monkey. N for nightingale.
O for ox. P for pig.
Let's put the bird in the nest.
The baby bird is happy now.
Q for queen bee. R for rabbit.
S for snake. T for tiger.
It's red, white, yellow, green, blue.
This is a cat. It's black.
This is a pencil. It's yellow.
This is a bird. It's green.
This is a fish. It's red.
This is an eraser. It's white.
This is a ruler. It's blue.
One for you, and one for me.
Uu duck. Vv dove. Ww swan.
Xx fox. Yy yak. Zz zebra.
